name: Failing You, Heavy in My Heart

passive_description.localized: Grants the wearer <lv>1</> stack of Spider Knowledge when dealing damage with Basic Attacks, up to <lv>8</> stacks (up to <lv>1</> stack every <lv>0.5</>s). All stacks are consumed when casting Ultimate. Increases the entire team's ATK by <lv>{1}</> for <lv>{0}</>s <lv>per</> stack consumed. Increases ATK by an additional <lv>{2}</> when <lv>8</> stacks are consumed.
passive_description.source: 装备者通过「普通攻击」造成伤害可使自身获得<lv>1</>层「蜘识」，最多叠加<lv>8</>层，每<lv>0.5</>秒最多获得<lv>1</>层「蜘识」。装备者释放「极轨终结」时消耗所有「蜘识」，每消耗<lv>1</>层「蜘识」可以让全队在<lv>{0}</>秒内攻击力提升<lv>{1}</>；若消耗的「蜘识」数量为<lv>8</>，则额外使全队攻击力提升<lv>{2}</>。

tested_hypotheses: Normal Attack damage hits grant 1 stack of Spider Knowledge up to 8 stacks; the trigger matches InputActionRole::Normal or a category-A packet.
Stack accumulation enforces a 0.5s (500,000 us) internal cooldown between stack gains; the figure is description-bound.
Casting Ultimate consumes all Spider Knowledge stacks from the wearer.
If at least 1 stack is consumed on Ultimate cast, the team receives a shared team ATK percentage buff (BuffRecipient::TeamAll) for 10.0s.
If exactly 8 stacks are consumed, an additional bonus equal to buff_spider_AtkUp2 is added to the team ATK percentage buff; a 9th stack is not granted.
The team ATK buff activates before simultaneous Ultimate hit damage delivery.
Casting Ultimate with 0 stacks grants no team ATK buff.
Weapon is restricted to Group FOUR characters; wearers from other groups are rejected at projection.
